data.name: Ayesha
data.gender_notes: Ayesha is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Variant of ʿĀʾisha, from the Arabic root ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh), 'to live'. Its root is ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh). Borne by ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr, wife of the Prophet ﷺ. Ayesha is a Arabic name meaning “Alive; living; prosperous”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ayesha expresses “Alive; living; prosperous”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant of ʿĀʾisha, from the Arabic root ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh), 'to live'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayesha total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
